Game Overview

At its heart, Animal Boxing is a boxing game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Animal Boxing doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Animal Boxing?

Animal Boxing is a free boxing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Animal Boxing free to play?

Yes, Animal Boxing is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
